newsitem.title: USA: Topro unit wins $2.6 mln in new contracts.
newsitem.headline: Topro unit wins $2.6 mln in new contracts.

text.p: Topro Inc said on Friday that its Vision Engineering Inc subsidiary received new contracts worth more than $2.6 million from Coca-Cola Co and Amgen Manufacturing Inc.
The California-based systems integrator received $2.2 million in new orders from Coca-Cola for computer automation upgrades and a new computer automation system.
It received more than $400,000 in orders from Amgen to apply ultra-violet matrix codes at a Puerto Rico facility and to install automated equipment.
Topro provides software configuration and system design in the process control industry.
